sloka: श्रोत्रयोः उभयोः मध्ये तप्त नाराच सन्निभम् ।उपशृण्वंतु मे सर्वे साक्षिनो हि वनेचराः ॥३-४५-३१॥
transliteration: śrotrayoḥ ubhayoḥ madhye tapta nārāca sannibham ।upaśṛṇvaṁtu me sarve sākṣino hi vanecarāḥ ॥3-45-31॥

translations.english: I speak what is just while you use harsh and unjust words. Let all beings who move in the forest bear witness.
